findings.title: A worked public route is cut
findings.claim: The focus presents the named peoples' diversion as the interruption of an already usable route: a worked road with walkers and travelers is cut until movement and access fail.
findings.mechanism: The focus path and transitive turning-away form meet the pericope's exact road-cutting context; the retained worked-road, traveler, stranding, and road-blocking images explain obstruction as damage to shared mobility.
findings.reader_payoff: The obstruction becomes visible as an attack on a public route and its users, not only as an inward change of preference.
findings.containment: The ordinary path and turning-away remain intact. Water crossing is excluded, and the finding does not make every route a religious path or make the focus word mean walking or robbery.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and its retained branches have exact focus or context carriers plus independent local triggers, while the water branches fail that test.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names the path from which the named peoples are turned away.
branch_activations.activation: The context's walkers make the blocked route a lived passage whose interruption reaches ordinary movement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's obstruction includes the stoppage of pedestrian movement along a shared route.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus word is not translated as walking; this is a contextual movement image.

findings.title: Dwelling gathers an inhabited belonging

findings.containment: This remains a local social reading of the dwellings. It does not equate every kinship or hospitality image with the focus and does not claim that belonging itself secures anyone.

findings.title: An inhabited structure can fail as security
findings.claim: The pericope exposes a failed stability design: a settled, visible, and inhabited-looking structure can still collapse when pride and chosen supports govern it.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace links the focus's fixed place to preceding collapse and following proofs, then to the weak house. The retained exact branches join location, disclosure, and shelter; unresolved HFT-only roles remain outside the finding.
findings.reader_payoff: Past ruins, pride, culpable outcomes, and the weak house become two scales of one question: what makes apparent stability able to carry life.
findings.containment: This is an attributed exploratory synthesis. It does not decide that 29:41 is only about ruins or convert unresolved HFT roles into lexical facts; the ordinary historical and parabolic readings remain recoverable.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy_unbound and its target morphology is not supplied; only branches with registered glosses and exact focus/context contacts are retained.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sabit yer ve konum bildiren özel kullanımlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus plural dwelling term carries places, positions, and established arrangements.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:37 fixes bodies in their dwellings and 29:40 follows with varied material outcomes.
branch_activations.activation: The preceding collapse and following consequences reassess the stability implied by an established place.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A settled location can look fixed while remaining exposed to a larger failure of security.
branch_activations.boundary: The body-specific and special-place variants are not being claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus clarity verb carries what becomes visible and understandable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:39 pairs clear proofs with pride and 29:40 pairs culpability with material outcomes.
branch_activations.activation: Visible proof remains present while the following sequence shows that pride and culpability can govern what follows.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failed stability is exposed rather than hidden: its defect can be seen in the sequence of proof and outcome.
branch_activations.boundary: The HFT synthesis does not make every visible thing a proof.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus clarity term carries explicit evidence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:39 supplies the next named sequence of clear proofs met by pride.
branch_activations.activation: The proof's presence makes the later failure a defect in the stability design rather than an absence of information.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The architecture fails in the presence of evidence, not because the evidence never emerged.
branch_activations.boundary: The explicit-proof specialization is retained only as this bounded HFT contact.

branch_activations.facet_statement: shelter and dwelling
branch_activations.carrier: 29:41 carries the explicit shelter and dwelling image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names settled dwellings and 29:43 frames the house example as something to be understood.
branch_activations.activation: The shelter analogy becomes diagnostic when it is read beside settled places, visible proof, and the call to understand the example.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: An inhabited-looking refuge may fail at the level of the support it promises.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved alliance, spider, weakness, culpability, and intellect branch refs are not silently promoted.

findings.title: A fragile web can obstruct sight
findings.claim: As an exploratory material analogy, beautification can be pictured as a fragile web-like film laid across the path of sight, leaving discernment present beneath the obstruction.
findings.mechanism: The focus path is paired with its own visual-sight term, and the spider-house's exact weak-web scene supplies the independent material trigger; together they alter the obstruction from an abstract barrier to a thin covering.
findings.reader_payoff: Something visibly weak can still interfere with seeing and choosing, so the obstacle need not be strong to be effective.
findings.containment: This is a surprising analogy, never a lexical translation of ٱلسَّبِيلِ. It retains the ordinary road and sight readings, and the unresolved spider and weakness branch refs are not treated as independently verified lexicon evidence.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy_unbound, but its exact focus path and sight carriers meet the supplied spider-house context; the material image remains explicitly bounded.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Gözün üzerinde görüşü örten ağsı bir perde oluşturan hastalığı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus path carries the retained eye-film branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus also supplies visual sight, while 29:41 supplies an actual spider-house and weak shelter scene.
branch_activations.activation: The path and sight words meet the web-like obstruction image, allowing the focus's blockage to be pictured as a covering across perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The obstruction can be thin and film-like while still interrupting the field through which discernment moves.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a material analogy, not a medical claim about the named peoples.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Perdenin örümcek ağına benzemesi ve kırmızı damarlar taşıması ayırıcı görünüşüdür.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus path carries the spider-web-like appearance branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The sight term and the exact spider-house context provide separate visual and material grounding.
branch_activations.activation: The web appearance makes the obstruction's fragility and its visual interference perceptible together.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A weak-looking film can be imagined across the path of sight without erasing sight itself.
branch_activations.boundary: The appearance is retained as an outlier image and not as the ordinary meaning of the path.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus sight term carries bodily seeing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The path word supplies the route across which the eye-film analogy is placed, and 29:41 supplies the web material.
branch_activations.activation: Sight remains the perceptual ground that lets a fragile covering explain how the obstruction is experienced.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Discernment persists beneath the obstruction even while the path through which it operates is visually interfered with.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not replace the focus's inner or ordinary interpretive dimensions.

findings.title: The named peoples open a case ledger
findings.claim: In a contained split-root resonance, naming ʿAd and Thamud begins a countable case sequence: visible remains can be read alongside an offense and its outcome.
findings.mechanism: The non-dominant count branch at عادًا meets the focus's clear and inspectable form and the following كلًّا ... بذنب sequence; the names become a ledger-like arrangement without losing their proper-name identity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list as a sequence of inspectable cases whose traces and consequences are paired.
findings.containment: The dominant proper-name reading remains intact. Counting is a bounded split-root formal resonance, not an etymology or translation of عَادًا, and the unresolved offense and total-inclusion branches are omitted.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy_unbound, but the retained count and disclosure branches have registered facets and exact focus/context contacts; the remaining HFT branches are unresolved.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sayma, sayı ve sayıya göre bir topluluğa katma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin birimlerini sayıp toplam miktarını belirleme işlemi.
branch_activations.carrier: The proper name ʿAd carries the registered non-dominant count branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:40 closes over the preceding cases with an each-case judgment sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The counted-name possibility meets the later case-closing structure and gives the paired names a ledger-like formal pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The names can be heard as opening a set of cases to be inspected one by one, alongside their visible remains.
branch_activations.boundary: ʿAd remains the proper name of the people; the count branch is not offered as derivation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus clarity term carries cases becoming visible and understandable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:40 supplies the following one-by-one consequence structure.
branch_activations.activation: The disclosure branch makes the counted sequence inspectable rather than a bare enumeration of names.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Each named case can be read through what its visible remains disclose and what follows from it.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not independently establish the unresolved offense or total-inclusion images.

findings.title: Beautification governs the reading of deliberate works
findings.claim: The next context makes the beautified object more precise: it is their deliberate work, evaluated in the presence of clear proof, pride, and later culpable outcomes.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairing زَيَّنَ ... أَعْمَالَهُمْ is returned to by 29:39's clear proofs and pride and 29:40's offense-outcome frame, so the obstruction is a change in valuation of acts rather than the disappearance of evidence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the path obstruction as a failure in judging one's own acts even while proof remains available.
findings.containment: This sharpens the focus's ordinary beautification-of-deeds statement without making every work false or redefining either focus word. The historical and path readings remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus action carrier and the supplied 29:39-29:40 context form an independent macro contact through registered focus branches.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey güzelleştirilir veya onda bulunan güzellik eylem ya da söz yoluyla görünür hale getirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries active beautification or making an attractive quality visible.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following context joins clear proofs and pride to the later account of culpable outcomes.
branch_activations.activation: Beautification is therefore read as an evaluative action that can alter how conduct appears before the actor.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The act of making deeds attractive becomes the hinge through which evidence and direction are separated.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that this branch replaces the focus's ordinary Form II action.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus deed-object carries deliberate action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:39 supplies clear proofs met by pride, and 29:40 links each group to an offense and outcome.
branch_activations.activation: The surrounding sequence makes the object of beautification responsible action rather than an unspecified possession.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The diversion concerns how deliberate works are valued and followed despite available proof.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not add a moral verdict to every action or activate the fee, office, or other work branches.

findings.title: Insight is presented as an established state
findings.claim: The closing state of being discerning is sharpened by the surrounding repeated forms of being: discernment is presented as an established condition, while the later parable asks whether understanding is actually present.
findings.mechanism: The focus's past auxiliary and insight participle meet the repeated كَانَ forms in 29:39-29:41 and the conditional knowing in 29:41; this makes the irony a failure of an existing capacity to govern direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The problem becomes the failure of a present faculty or state to direct action, not the absence of a faculty altogether.
findings.containment: This is a grammatical and contextual sharpening, not a claim that every ك و ن form shares one meaning or that the focus state guarantees right judgment.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus auxiliary and participle and the supplied repeated-state context support a bounded macro reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus auxiliary carries an already-held state of being.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding contexts repeat being-forms and culminate in the conditional question of knowing.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated state language lets the focus's discernment stand as a condition already present before the later test of understanding.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: They are shown as possessing an established capacity while their direction and judgment still fail.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the grammatical auxiliary into an independent theological claim.

findings.title: The blocked path is also the requested straight course
findings.claim: Under the explicitly added Fatiha overlay, the focus's definite path also appears as the straight course being requested, while straying marks the opposite directional outcome.
findings.mechanism: The focus path carrier meets 1:6's request for guidance to the straight path and 1:7's distinction from the paths of anger and straying; this adds a petitionary directional frame beyond the native road-cutting context.
findings.reader_payoff: The obstruction now has a precise counter-movement: the route that can be cut is also the course a community asks to be led along.
findings.containment: Only individual 1:6 and 1:7 contacts are retained. The overlay does not import a whole-surah theology, redefine سَبِيل lexically, or displace the native claim that the named peoples were turned from it.

epistemic.reason: The external ayat are explicit macro members and supply a specific path-and-guidance contact that adds petitionary direction beyond the native road-cutting finding.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: Belirli dinsel söz öbeklerinde doğruluğa, iyiliğe veya kurtuluşa yönelten yolu belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus definite path carries the route named as the object of diversion.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 1:6 requests guidance to the straight path and 1:7 distinguishes its recipients from anger and straying.
branch_activations.activation: The external prayer gives the focus route a direct petitionary orientation and supplies a concrete counter-direction to being turned away.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path is newly heard as a course a community asks to be guided along, in addition to being the route from which the named peoples were diverted.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not make سَبِيل and صِرَاط identical or import the whole of Fatiha into the focus.
